explanation: Negates the strong form "codimension O(log K)", per Green's 2025 update (Hosseini, Alweiss): a Hamming ball of radius n/2 − √n has a complement of size O(n), but A − A (= A + A in characteristic 2) contains no subspace of codimension o(√n). That contradicts C·log K + D = O(log n). The encoding is faithful, and a formal proof is linked.
